apps.name: Nuvio Enhanced
apps.versionDescription:
# 🚀 Release v0.3.2

## Upstream changelog:
- feat(auth): register official client devices @tapframe
- Update Play account and foreground service compliance @tapframe
- fix(ui): clip CardDepthEffect sheen overlay to shape path @quiettinkerer
- refactor: remove catalog header accent line @tapframe
- feat(library): search the cloud library @Laskco
- feat(mdblist): add MyAnimeList (MAL) rating from MDBList API @guuilp
- fix: per-profile isolation for Trakt auth and storage @guuilp
- fix(android): correct fill/zoom image based subtitle rendering @darkflame91

## Enhanced changelog:
- All changes from the upstream
- fix(ios): subtitle opaque-box @luqmanfadlli 
- feat: add Live TV tab to floating pil navigation @luqmanfadlli
- fix(android): fix ExoPlayer playback not starting @luqmanfadlli 
- fix(ios): resolve persistent home bar on iOS 16-18 @luqmanfadlli 
- fix(ios): resolve double legacy navbar on iOS 16-18 @luqmanfadlli
- feat(ios): hero trailer playback @luqmanfadlli 
- chore: update inAppLogger @luqmanfadlli
- feat(ios): add profile insight page inspired by yesnt10
- fix(ios): resolve regression from playerSurfaceSourceUrl @luqmanfadlli 
- fix(ios): resolve regression from collection folder header patch @luqmanfadlli 
---

## Variants

### Nuvio Full
This variant is built from the official source without any modifications or additions.

AltStore/SideStore source:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luqmanfadlli/NuvioMobile-iOS/main/NuvioFull.json
```

### Nuvio Enhanced
This custom variant includes experimental features, quality-of-life improvements, and specific bug fixes not yet available in the upstream repository.

AltStore/SideStore source:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luqmanfadlli/NuvioMobile-iOS/main/NuvioEnhanced.json
```

**Added Features:**
- iOS: Added adaptive hide/unhide Liquid Glass NavBar on scroll. 
- iOS: Added experimental PiP for iOS and iPadOS.
- iOS: Added hero trailer playback.
- All: Added a volume boost feature (up to 200%) for quieter streams (volume up gesture can go beyond 100%).
- All: Added support for Live TV integrations.
- All: Added stream quality selection in Player Control.
- All: Added artwork type selection for Hero background.
- All: Added Trakt alternative auth method to support LiveContainer user.
- All: Relocated Trakt configuratzion into the Integrations Settings menu.
- All: Added Tap-to-Seek (you can tap on player progress bar to seek forward/backward).
- All: Added in-app debug logs (go to Settings -> Advanced -> Debug Logs).
- All: Changed the "Play" button to "Watch Again" for already-watched movies to improve tracking clarity.
- All: Added Library Calendar.
- All: Added playback info button.
- All: Added adjustable subtitle background transparency.
- All: Added episode rating toggle in TMDB Enrichment.
- All: Added profile insight page.

**Bug Fixes:**
- iOS: Fixed persistent home bar on iOS 16-18. 
- iOS: Fixed double legacy navbar on iOS 16-18.
- iOS: Fixed animated GIF support for Profile Avatars.
- iOS: Fixed animated GIF support for Stream Badge.
- Android: Fixed status bar visibility

---
> **💡 Note**
I don’t accept personal donations and my release doesn’t change donation URL. All donations should rightfully go to @tapframe.
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio Enhanced includes exclusive experimental features, volume boosting, and performance fixes not available in the upstream build.
